title: `approvedCreditor` not reset after account transfer
summary: ## Severity  **Impact**: High, user can steal funds from liquidated account  **Likelihood**: Medium, requires either a bad debt account, or L2 to be offline for some time  ## Description  The Arcadia accounts support a secondary backup creditor which is stored in the `approvedCreditor` storage variable, and can be set by the owner. The issue is that when an account is transferred, this variable is not reset, and the old owner essentially can have a backdoor to the system.
